document.abstract: Proper service and maintenance of theater reproducing equipment has been an important consideration in bringing the art to its present high state of development. Improved service instruments and techniques have been necessary to keep pace with the rapid improvements made during the past decade and will continue to be important factors in the post-war period. The instrument described here is a new departure in the field of service as applied to theater equipment.
